purpose: Freeze the currently unresolved but explicitly understood data gaps for V1 without weakening provenance, freshness, PIT, or fail-closed rules.
governance_rule: A documented expected gap remains fail-closed and may be reopened only when new official-source evidence, archived vintage data, or an exact transformation contract makes certification possible without proxy substitution or methodology weakening.

gaps.reason: Official SNB variants and simple pairwise aggregations do not reproduce the runtime history exactly; original statistical provenance or an exact transformation contract is not preserved.
gaps.reopen_condition: Exact official SNB series, archived vintage, or deterministic transformation contract reproducing the runtime history.

gaps.reason: The official SNB source family is identified, but no tested dimensional series or simple pairwise aggregation reproduces the runtime history exactly.
gaps.reopen_condition: Verifiable exact original SNB statistical series, archived vintage, or deterministic transformation contract reproducing the runtime observations.

gaps.reason: The official BOJ reserve-balances source is semantically aligned but neither a tested single MD08 series nor pairwise aggregation reproduces the 128-month runtime history exactly; original vintage provenance is absent.
gaps.reopen_condition: Exact BOJ series, archived vintage, or deterministic transformation contract reproducing the historical runtime.

gaps.reason: Homogeneous official T-5 settlement history is unavailable to the current automated environment; archive access is Datamine-routed/blocked.
gaps.reopen_condition: Reproducible official homogeneous historical settlements with source-defined temporal eligibility.

gaps.reason: Free official historical files do not expose the required settlement prices on a reproducible homogeneous basis.
gaps.reopen_condition: Reproducible official homogeneous historical settlements with deterministic 3M/6M/12M mapping and temporal eligibility.

gaps.reason: Public metadata does not expose reproducible daily official historical settlement prices as a free public series.
gaps.reopen_condition: Reproducible official EOD settlement history with deterministic temporal eligibility.

gaps.authority: Reserve Bank of New Zealand / NZD OIS market
gaps.instrument: NZD OIS linked to OCR expectations
gaps.reason: RBNZ public data do not publish the required OIS curve and standard swap series are not a clean OCR/OIS substitute.
gaps.reopen_condition: Official or directly licensed reproducible NZD OIS history satisfying the existing PIT contract without proxy substitution.
